sequencing_rationale: Begin with broad solid-state concepts before structure and specialized phases.
Crystal order provides the spatial foundation for band and lattice reasoning.
Semiconductors follow basic solids and periodic structure.
Magnetic order extends many-particle solid-state foundations.
Superconductivity follows electronic, magnetic and phase-transition foundations.
Quantum materials are an advanced extension after core condensed-matter foundations.
Soft matter applies thermodynamic and collective reasoning to mesoscale materials without replacing basic solid-state foundations.
